title: fix: simplify agent guidance and remove stale workflows
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Condenses repeated feedback into practical coding principles: radical YAGNI, plain data and functions, clear one-way data flow, loose coupling, and migrations over permanent compatibility code.
- Replaces automatic rule growth with narrow curation and checks current decisions before reviving work; removes duplicated references and templates while preserving the team ownership table.
- Allows task-related staging database migrations/resets without repeated confirmation and aligns Tinybird guidance; preserves production and secret approval requirements.
- Aligns production sync with promotion PRs and removes the direct-merge script. Adds no runtime features or new skills; net removal: 282 lines.
- Validation: three skill schemas and whitespace checks pass; reviewed guidance against eight recent tasks and earlier feedback. Biome does not process these Markdown files.

gist.headline: Less scripture, more signal
gist.blurb: The hive pruned its agent handbook down to the rules that actually help code ship. Production still gets its guardrails; staging migrations can now get on with it.
gist.summary: Condensed AGENTS.md and Claude skill guidance around YAGNI, plain data, one-way flow, loose coupling, and migrations, while removing the direct production-merge script and allowing task-related staging database resets without repeated confirmation.
gist.impact: Contributors and coding agents now get shorter, curated guidance, promotion-PR-based production syncs, and a clearer path for staging migrations while production and secret approvals remain protected.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a thoughtful gardener-librarian pruning an overgrown stack of rule scrolls into a small, useful handbook, while a safe staging garden gets freshly turned soil. A nearby CRT robot watches a clearly marked promotion path from staging to production, with a locked gate protecting production.
